description: 8 retrieval probes for go-chi/chi — an MIT-licensed Go HTTP router with radix-trie route storage, interface embedding (Router embeds Routes + http.Handler), and many receiver methods on the Mux type.

probes.query: how does chi dispatch incoming HTTP requests to matching route handlers
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: Mux.ServeHTTP (line 63) is the entry point that finds the matching route and invokes the handler

probes.query: how does chi build a routing trie for fast prefix matching
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: node.InsertRoute (line 139) inserts a pattern + handler into the radix tree

probes.query: how does chi compose middleware functions around request handlers
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: Mux.Use (line 100) appends middleware onto the router stack; core middleware composition

probes.query: chi Mux struct that implements the Router interface
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: Mux struct (line 21) is the concrete router implementation

probes.query: chi Router interface defining the routing methods
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: Router interface (chi.go:66) is the public API surface

probes.query: chi NewRouter constructor that creates a Mux
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: NewRouter (chi.go:60) returns a *Mux; small signature-anchored target

probes.query: chi radix tree node with prefix children and endpoint map
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: node struct (line 88) has pointer-recursive fields (children) plus method-keyed endpoint map (endpoints map[methodTyp]*endpoint). Exercises tree-sitter-go's handling of map-typed struct fields with composite key/value types

probes.query: chi Router interface embedding http.Handler and Routes
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: `type Router interface { http.Handler; Routes; ... }` (chi.go:66-70) — interface embedding via bare type names (not methods). Exercises tree-sitter-go's parsing of qualified embedded interfaces (`http.Handler`) alongside method declarations in the same interface body
